query:
SELECT cr.name as role_name, rp.module, rp.submodule, rp.permissionLevel 
FROM custom_roles cr 
LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON cr.id = rp.roleId 
WHERE cr.name = 'manutencao'
ORDER BY rp.module, rp.submodule;
